text: Childminder here, I've got a 7 year old boy staying overnight while his mum's away and I need a clear answer please. Temp is 38.9, I took it twice to be sure. About twenty minutes ago I spotted some marks on his legs and lower back. I think they're purplish-red, some tiny like pin pricks and a couple bigger like little bruises, though I'm not sure if the bigger ones were there this afternoon. I did the glass test because I'd read about it, pressed the side of a tumbler on them, and as far as I can tell they don't fade at all. Still there, same colour. I might be doing it wrong, the light's not great in his room, but I tried a few different spots and got the same result. I don't want to overreact, but I also don't want to sit on this. Do I take him in now or call his mum first? Just tell me what you'd do.
